title: Homogeneity of Recombination
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $A$ be a finite set of nonzero elements of $F$, let $c\in F$, and let $f$ assign a field element to each nonzero element of $F$. Recombining the values $c f(i)$ from $A$ equals $c$ times the recombination of $f$ from $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of nonzero field elements
$f$ is a function from the nonzero elements of $F$ to $F$
